title: 3gqi.2.3: Integrate GNSS sim with TDMA time sync validation
description: Wire the GNSS sim (3gqi.2.1/.2) into the LICHEN time sync path: firmware receives NMEA, parses GPS time, feeds to TDMA scheduler. Validate that simulated GPS time propagates through the time provider to the TDMA slot assignment. Test with known epoch + SFN correlation. Depends on 3gqi.2.1 and 3gqi.2.2.
